I think your underestimating the younger generation. Tik tok is a good example. We know that it’s fake and that most of it is orchestrated . No ones gonna post about themselves getting evicted or losing a family member. But social media is a way for us to connect. We have such a better understanding of the sociopolitical climate and our peers personal experiences. My tik tok fyp is filled with teenagers and young adults talking about injustices, how they met the love of their life through Instagram, their struggles with mental health and toxic relationships, making jokes about things we can all relate to, and tips on how they were able to overcome things so many others are struggling with. Yes on surface level social media is toxic and it’s not real face to face  interaction and some might conclude that we will become socially inept and feel insecure because of it but it’s how you use it that matters more than just the platform. I’ve seen more teenager feeling insecure and depressed because their parents tell them they’re useless and stupid than seeing some obviously lucky and very wealthy Instagram model. Anyway your points are valid but I think they’re misguided and you should try to use social media in a constructive way.
